total_model.summary: Model projects 45.2 total points (LV 22, SEA 23). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 0.7), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 0.6), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
